content: En Kadaudok en Pensamin ar Pwoud kan
Ni mehn Israel ko ar pokonpene nan Mispa, re ahpw wiahda inou lap ehu ong KAUN-O: “Sohte emen reht me pahn mweidohng nah serepein en pwoudikihda mehn Pensamin.”
Mehn Israel ko eri kohla Pedel oh mwohndi wasao mwohn silangin KAUN-O lao lel nin soutik. Re ahpw mwahiei ni ngihl laud oh nsensuwed, patopatohwan,
“Maing KAUN, Koht en Israel, dahme irair wet wiawihkihong kiht, dahme kadaudok en Pensamin nektehn sohrala sang Israel?”
Nin sohrahnie mandahn rahno irail eri pwourda oh kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao. Re ahpw patohwanda meirong en kaminimin oh meirong isihs pwonte.

Re ahpw kalelapak, patohwan, “Mie pwihn ehu sang ni kadaudok en Israel me sohte iang pokonpene mwohn silangin KAUN-O nan Mispa?” (Re wiahda mahs inou lap ehu me dene mehmen me sohte pahn iang pokon nan Mispa pahn kamakamala.)
Mehn Israel ko inenen nsensuwedkihla riarail mehn Pensamin ko oh patohwan, “Rahnwet ehu kadaudok en Israel pwupwulahr.
Kitail pahn kihsang ia lih me pahn kak pwoudikihda ohl en Pensamin kan me luhwehdi? Kitail wiadahr inou lap ehu me kitail sohte pahn kihong mehn Pensamin kan en pwoudiki neitail serepein kan.”
Ni ar idekda ma mie pwihn ehu sang ni kadaudok en Israel me sohte iang pokonpene nan Mispa, re diarada me sohte emen sang Sapes nan Kilead me iang mi wasao;
Ni likwer eh wiawihong tohn karis ko sohte mehn Sapes me sapeng.
Eri, pokono ahpw kadarala sounpei 12,000 sang rehn me keieu kommwad oh kehkehlingkihong irail, “Kumwail kohwei oh kemehla aramas koaros nan Sapes, iangahki lih akan oh seri kan.
Kumwail kemehla ohl koaros, iangahki lih me sohte meipwon koaros.”
Re diarada meipwon pahpwiki rehn mehn Sapes ko; irail eri kahreiraildo Sailo, kahnimpwal me mi nan wehin Kenan.
Pokono pwon ahpw kadaralahng pakair ong mehn Pensamin me mihmi Paipen Rimmon oh peki pwe mahwen en katoktokdi.
Mehn Pensamin ko eri pwurodo; mehn Israel eri kihong irail serepein en Sapes ko me re sohte kemehla. Ahpw serepein ko sohte itarohng irail.
Aramas ako ahpw nsensuwedkihla mehn Pensamin pwehki KAUN-O eh ketin kauwehla minimin nanpwungen kadaudok en Israel.
Kaunen pokono eri patohwan, “Solahr lih nan kadaudok en Pensamin. Kitail pahn kihsang ia lih pwe re en pwoudikihda ohl me luwehdi kan?
Ehu kisehn kadaudok eisek riaun Israel kan sohte pahn pwupwula. Kitail pahn rapahkihda ehu ahl pwe kadaudok en Pensamin en mihmiehte,
ahpw kitail sohte kak mweidohng neitail serepein kan en pwoudikinirailda, pwehki atail wiadahr keriao ong mehmen me pahn mweidohng mehn Pensamin men en pwoudikihda neitail serepein kan.”
Re ahpw medemedewe, “Pokon en sarawi nan Sailo kerendohr.” (Sailo mihte paliepeng en Pedel, palieir en Lepona, oh palimesehn ahl me mi nanpwungen Pedel oh Sekem.)
Irail ndahng mehn Pensamin ko, “Kumwail kohwei oh rukula nan mwetin wain kan, oh

mwasamwasahn. Ahnsou me serepein en Sailo kan pahn kohiei pwe re en kahlek rahn sarawio, kumwail pwarada sang nan mwetin wain kan. Emenemen kumwail ahpw pahn parokedi emen serepein oh walahng nan sapwen Pensamin.

Ma arail pahpa de riarail pwutak kan kohdo oh lingeringerkihong kumwail, kumwail kak ndahng irail, ‘Kumwail menlau mweidohng kiht serepein pwukat, pwe se sohte aleiraildi nan mahwen, oh kumwail sohte kauwehkihla amwail inou pwe kaidehn kumwail me kihong kiht.’”

Mehn Pensamin eri kapwaiada met; emenemen pilada eh pwoud sang rehn serepein ko me wie kahkahlek nan Sailo oh wahda. Re ahpw pwurala nan uhdakarail, onehda sapahl arail kahnimw kan, oh koukousoan wasao.
Ni ahnsowohte mehn Israel ko me luhwehdi ahpw mwesel oh emenemen pwurala nan uhdahn kadaudoke oh peneinei oh nan uhdahn eh wasa.
Ni ahnsowo sohte nanmwarki nan Israel. Emenemen kin pein wiewia nsene.
